name: YouTube
description: Ubiquitous video client. Safe to remove if using browser-based or third-party alternatives.

name: YouTube Music
description: Streaming service. High RAM overhead; no impact on system audio drivers.

name: Google TV / Play Movies
description: Rental and purchase portal for video content.

name: Google Play Books
description: E-book and audiobook interface; safe to replace with FOSS readers.

name: Google News / Newsstand
description: Legacy news aggregator; redundant in modern firmware.

name: Google Arts & Culture
description: Educational app; contains no background daemons critical to the OS.

name: Google Play Games
description: Manages gaming profiles and achievements; removing affects game cloud saves but not device stability.

name: Google Drive
description: Primary cloud storage client. Removing it may break 'open with' intents for Drive files.

name: Google Docs
description: Document editor; safe to replace with Collabora or local editors.

name: Google Sheets
description: Spreadsheet editor; purely user-facing utility.

name: Google Slides
description: Presentation tool; no systemic dependencies.

name: Google Keep
description: Note-taking app; safe to remove if using local note-taking apps.

name: Google Duo / Meet
description: Video calling client; removal does not affect the standard Dialer.

name: Google Fit
description: Health tracking; interacts with sensors but is not required for their operation.

name: Blogger
description: Legacy blog management tool; no system relevance.

name: Google Feedback
description: Handles crash reports and user feedback prompts. Disabling it prevents these prompts.

name: Google Partner Setup
description: Enables applications to perform functionality that requires access to Google account information for third-party partnerships.

name: Print Recommendation Service
description: Provides suggestions for printing services. Basic printing via the system print spooler remains functional.

name: Google One Time Init
description: Typically runs only once after the initial boot to download required apps. Serves no purpose afterwards.

name: AICore
description: Handles on-device AI tasks. All 'GenAI' features in Dialer, Messages, and Recorder will stop functioning, but safe to remove.

name: Gboard
description: Core keyboard interface.
risk_factor: CRITICAL: Password entry failure if removed without replacement (e.g. HeliBoard).

name: Pixel Launcher
description: Primary home screen launcher.
risk_factor: CRITICAL: Black screen/navigation failure if removed without another launcher (e.g. Lawnchair).

name: Google Chrome
description: Default web browser.
risk_factor: Loss of default web handler for external links. System WebView might also be affected.

name: Phone by Google
description: Core telephony UI.
risk_factor: Must be replaced to manage active calls.

name: Google Messages
description: Essential for SMS/MMS.
risk_factor: Removal breaks RCS but not standard telephony.

name: Google Contacts
description: Required for managing local and synced address books.
risk_factor: Must be replaced to view contacts.

name: Files by Google
description: Required for file-picking intents from other applications.
risk_factor: Breaks file pickers if no replacement.

name: Google Calendar
description: Safe to remove; data is managed by the underlying Calendar Provider.
risk_factor: Alarms or scheduled tasks might need an alternative.

name: Google Clock
description: Core clock and timer app.
risk_factor: Removal may disable active alarms; must be replaced.

name: Google Assistant
description: Purely a voice-interface overlay.
risk_factor: Disables the 'Hey Google' trigger and long-press power button shortcuts.

name: Speech Services by Google
description: Text-to-speech engine.
risk_factor: Apps that rely on voice output will go silent.

name: TalkBack
description: Accessibility service.
risk_factor: Critical for visually impaired users. May interfere with dynamic volume settings on some OEMs.

name: Google Play Services
description: Acts as a device administrator and a bridge to nearly every other application.
risk_factor: EXTREME DANGER: Constant crash notifications. Bootloop if not removed as Device Admin first.

name: Google Services Framework
description: Manages the device's unique GSF ID.
risk_factor: EXTREME DANGER: Prevents communication with Google servers. Apps fail SafetyNet/Play Integrity checks.

name: Google Account Manager
description: Manages credential exchange for Google logins.
risk_factor: Impossible to sign into any Google-integrated services.

name: Android Services Library
description: Essential for notification ranking.
risk_factor: EXTREME DANGER: Its removal causes bootloops on Samsung/Xiaomi Android 12+.

name: Package Installer
description: Essential for installing, updating, and removing any software.
risk_factor: Removal breaks the pm service itself.

name: Setup Wizard
description: Initial configuration wizard.
risk_factor: On some Pixels and Sony devices, removal breaks the 'Home' and 'Recents' buttons.

name: Carrier Services
description: Provides framework for VoLTE and WiFi Calling.
risk_factor: Removal often leads to loss of cellular signal or SMS functionality.

name: Android Shared Library
description: Provides common code for system apps.
risk_factor: Removal leads to multiple 'NoSuchMethodError' crashes.

name: ConfigUpdater
description: Downloads security certificates and firewall configurations.
risk_factor: Removal can lead to secure connection failures.

name: Permission Controller
description: Manages runtime permission dialogs.
risk_factor: Removal prevents the user from granting permissions to new apps.

name: Search Selector
description: System UI overlay.
risk_factor: System UI may crash whenever attempting to use search from recents.

name: Contacts Sync
description: Background service for contact syncing.
risk_factor: Causes sync adapter failures and error popups.

name: Android Auto
description: In-car infotainment system connection.
risk_factor: Phone will no longer connect to car infotainment systems.

name: Android Switch
description: Migrates data from an old device.
risk_factor: Breaks the ability to migrate data.

name: Data Transfer Tool
description: Specialized migration tool for Pixel devices.
risk_factor: Breaks initial setup data transfer.

name: Digital Wellbeing
description: Screen-time tracking.
risk_factor: May break 'Recents/Overview' screen and cause Settings app crashes on Android 12+.

name: Device Policy
description: Enterprise management tool.
risk_factor: Breaks Enterprise/Work Profile functionality.

name: Personal Safety
description: Car crash detection and emergency SOS.
risk_factor: Disables emergency SOS sharing.

name: Google Fi
description: Carrier app for Google Fi.
risk_factor: Essential if using Google Fi as a carrier.

name: Google Authenticator
description: 2FA app.
risk_factor: Must be replaced to maintain 2FA access if tokens are stored here.

name: Find My Device
description: Remote tracking and wipe.
risk_factor: Phone can no longer be tracked or wiped remotely if lost.

name: Google Wallet
description: Mobile payments.
risk_factor: Disables NFC mobile payments.
